typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::HeaderSelectSQL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> HeaderTable
HeaderTable derive(DATA = DATA) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATA)) ~> HeaderFile
